limitations: This is a verified subset, not a complete subsidiary census. Unlisted counterparties must remain unknown.
Effective_from is the conservative dated evidence boundary, not necessarily acquisition date. Entries expire at the end of the fixed study window; review anew before prospective use.
Annual-report ownership evidence uses dated original Form 10-K contents, captured now. Original website posting timestamps are not established and must not be used as event availability timestamps.
A subsidiary ownership share does not establish the issuer portion of a project JV. Require separate contract-level attribution for JVs.
Punctuation and abbreviated trade-name matching must be conservative. No broad single-word Orion, Granite, Sterling or Primoris aliases are admitted.
PRIM Exhibit 21 identity evidence is a primary-source web factual transcription, separately distinguished from captured HTTP bodies.

STRL Texas Sterling, Ralph Wadsworth and Banicki ownership is explicitly supported by sole-owner signature capacities in the credit agreement filed June 9, 2025. Its local reference is a labelled primary-web factual review because direct HTTP capture returned 403. Corporate ownership does not establish project JV allocation.
